name: gpp-agent five-phase Grundschutz++ workflow
description: One eval case per phase covering the planning.md gatekeeper rules. Each case provides a user prompt that the classifier should route to the matching phase agent and asserts on the structured output. See gpp-agent/planning.md.

eval_cases.description: An SSP where the ISO and IT-Mgmt parties share a UUID. Phase 1 must list at least one sod_violation.

parts.text: Run the governance check on my Informationsverbund 'iv-demo-1'. The current SSP has the same party UUID assigned to the Information Security Officer role and the IT Management role. Does this violate the Segregation of Duties?

eval_cases.description: User picks a Component Definition that sets pwd_min_length=8 against a profile demanding >=12. Phase 2 must produce a non-empty blockers list.

parts.text: I'm registering a new Zielobjekt for the office network. I picked the standard server-room blueprint and set the minimum password length parameter to 8 characters. Is this consistent with the BSI profile? Show me any tailoring blockers.

eval_cases.description: A MUST control marked 'planned' without a date-expected. Phase 3 must populate planned_without_date and set not_certifiable=true.

parts.text: Please validate my SSP implementation statuses. Control BER.1.A2 is a MUSS requirement and I currently set it to 'planned' but I haven't filled in a date-expected yet. Is the SSP ready for initial certification in this state?

eval_cases.description: A syntactically broken OSCAL SSP. Phase 4 must return cleared_for_audit=false with non-empty schema_errors.

parts.text: Run the formal audit pre-check on my SSP for Informationsverbund 'iv-demo-1'. Schema validation just reported that the system-security-plan element is missing the required 'metadata' block. Can the SSP move into the assessment phase?

eval_cases.description: An Assessment Result with one or more 'not-satisfied' findings. Phase 5 must produce non-empty created_poam_items linked to the violated requirement and asset.

parts.text: The auditor finished and there are two 'not-satisfied' findings on controls BER.1.A2 and KONF.3.A4. Please create POA&M entries for both, linked to the affected asset UUIDs, and draft milestones. We will validate responsibilities afterwards.
